categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of various types of wires and cables, including power cables, bare copper wires, communication cables, solar system cables, and specialized cables such as low-smoke, halogen-free, anti-rodent, and high-temperature resistant cables. It also engages in electrical and telecommunication engineering, solar system design, construction, maintenance, and related technical services. Additionally, the company is involved in import-export trade and distribution of related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced cable manufacturing technologies including cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) insulation for power cables up to 161kV, low-smoke halogen-free materials, anti-rodent and anti-termite cable coatings, and high-temperature resistant steel-core aluminum wires. It emphasizes innovation in green energy cables such as TUV, UL, EN, and IEC certified solar cables, and is developing ultra-high voltage cables (230kV and 345kV) for offshore wind power and grid resilience. Production processes include wire drawing, stranding, insulation extrusion, jacketing, and quality inspection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves primarily domestic customers in Taiwan, including electric power utilities (Taiwan Power Company), public infrastructure projects (railways, metro systems, ports), industrial sectors such as steel and petrochemical plants, and emerging green energy projects like offshore wind and solar power plants. It also supplies communication network operators and electronic manufacturing industries. Overseas markets focus on Asia, including China, Southeast Asia, Oceania, and Africa.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are predominantly in Taiwan, accounting for about 99% of sales, with export markets mainly in Asia. The company is expanding its presence in emerging markets such as China, Southeast Asia, Oceania, and Africa through local production and sales bases to enhance competitiveness and service capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing wires and cables from raw materials such as copper and insulation compounds. It maintains long-term contracts with upstream suppliers for raw materials and serves downstream customers in power distribution, telecommunications, and industrial sectors. It also provides engineering and installation services, integrating upstream and downstream activities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core cable business, developing high value-added niche products like low-smoke halogen-free, anti-rodent, and ultra-high voltage cables, and expanding green energy cable solutions for offshore wind and solar power. R&D focuses on new materials, product certifications, and manufacturing process improvements to enhance quality and cost efficiency. The company also pursues digital transformation and smart manufacturing to boost competitiveness and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of various wire and cable products. The company also earns income from engineering services related to power and telecommunication projects, as well as from export sales. It maintains long-term contracts with key customers and engages in project-based sales for public and private infrastructure developments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic and international cable manufacturers from China, Japan, and Korea. It positions itself as a quality leader with recognized certifications and a strong reputation in Taiwan’s power cable and green energy markets. It leverages product innovation, specialized cables, and strategic alliances to maintain and grow market share amid intense competition and price pressures.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$6.58 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 6.28% increase over the prior year, with net profit after tax of NT$753 million, up 19.8%. It has a stable asset base of about NT$8.66 billion and equity of NT$7.6 billion. The company shows steady growth driven by domestic infrastructure demand and green energy projects, with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality, reliability, and innovation as its core value proposition, offering specialized cables that meet stringent safety and environmental standards such as low smoke, halogen-free, anti-rodent, and high-temperature resistance. It differentiates through certifications (TUV, UL, IEC), customized solutions for green energy and infrastructure projects, and strong customer service. Commitment to sustainability and ESG principles further enhances its competitive advantage.
